register.labelZh: BOOK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: book in 和 book into 可以表示抵達酒店或其他住宿地點後辦理入住。；你可以使用 book somebody in 或 book somebody into,表示為家人、朋友、旅客或自己安排酒店住宿。；當課程或活動名額有限時,可以使用 book up for 表示提早預留名額。；BOOK 片語動詞可以幫助你分辨旅客抵達後辦理入住,以及另一個人事先為他們安排住宿。
register.summaryEn: Book in and book into help you describe arriving at a hotel or another place and registering for your stay. You can use book somebody in or book somebody into when arranging a hotel stay for family members, friends, guests or yourself. Book up for is useful when a course or activity has limited places and you reserve one in advance. The BOOK family helps you distinguish between travellers registering after they arrive and another person arranging their accommodation beforehand.
